scope: Planning inventory of J directories using canonical complete RegExp/String report candidates and the shared ledger validator. Mixed source snapshots; not current-toolchain conformance or the coordinator whole-suite ledger. Prefix journals excluded. Directory rows overlap.
candidatePolicy: Canonical JSON filenames mentioning RegExp, String or cluster-j; pinned revision, clean checkout, native adapter; all variants validated by aggregateEvidence. Dates are report timestamps or first addition to this branch. Explicit variant subsets included through rootSelection. Candidate identities retained. Supersedes v3 planning inventory, which omitted focused subsets when matching selection names.
